goalSummary: An agent session lacks stable project-wide context at startup, or shows outdated retrieved knowledge on later prompts despite ongoing conversation activity.

facts.why: The file assembling per-turn Retrieved Knowledge segment must be identified
The two distinct injection pathways must be named to distinguish their trigger conditions
The authoritative documentation file for both injection pathways must be identified
The shared mechanism routing context to the appropriate injection pathway must be documented
The specific data components (semantic search results + KG entity context) assembled into the Retrieved Knowledge segment must be documented
